A chess app for the Mudita Kompakt, with a two-player mode for one phone.

A fork of Mudita's own open-source
[Kompakt Chess](https://github.com/mudita/MuditaOS-K-Chess-opensource). Everything the stock app
does is still here — play against Stockfish, adjustable difficulty, move suggestions, game
statistics — and two people can now play on one board, passing it back and forth.

It installs alongside the factory Chess app rather than replacing it, under its own application
id, so the phone keeps the app it came with.

## What it needs

Nothing. No permissions and no network — see [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

## The download

`chessplus.apk` and `chessplus-<version>.apk` are the same file. The unversioned one is there so
a link to it keeps working after the next release. Verify either against the `.sha256` beside it
if you like.

Free software under the GPLv3.
